definition.en: The ulna is one of the two long bones of the forearm and forms a major part of the elbow joint.

definition.en: The ulnar artery is a major forearm artery that contributes to blood supply of the hand.

definition.en: The ulnar nerve provides motor and sensory supply to parts of the forearm and hand.

explanation.en: Location: Medial arm and forearm into the hand. This is a schematic educational reference linked to the local 3D Anatomy viewer.
